title: ashwingopalsamy/india-repo-rate-dataset / decisions
description: Every announced decision in the ledger, from the bank’s own statement or resolution: hikes, cuts and holds, with the vote, stance, a short excerpt and the statement link.

meeting_id.description: The scheduled meeting this decision came from; null for an unscheduled (off-cycle) decision. Joins to `meetings`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

central_bank.description: Central bank that sets the rate.

decision_body.description: The committee that took the decision.

announced_at_local.description: Announcement time as published, with the bank’s UTC offset (ISO 8601).

announced_date.description: Announcement date in the bank’s local time.

effective_date.description: Date the decided rate took effect (the next day for the Fed).

level_kind.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

rate_pct.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

rate_bps.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

rate_low_pct.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

rate_high_pct.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

change_bps.description: Signed change in basis points; 0 for a hold. Null when the decision changed the instrument itself.

off_cycle.description: True for an unscheduled decision between meetings.

era_change.description: True when the decision introduced a new instrument or basis (for example the Fed’s move to a target range).

vote_for.description: Members voting for the decision; null where the vote is not captured.

vote_against.description: Members voting against; null where the vote is not captured.

dissents.description: Names or descriptions of dissenting votes, as published; empty when there were none or none were captured.

unanimous.description: True when no member voted against; null where the vote is not captured.

stance.description: The policy stance as stated by the bank (for example `neutral`, `calibrated tightening`), where it states one.

statement_url.description: Link to the official statement or resolution.

excerpt.description: A short excerpt from the statement (at most 400 characters).

evidence.description: `statement` for a decision read from the bank’s own statement or resolution.

source_ids.description: Sources for this decision; join to `sources`.

release_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the release this row was built from.

record_text.description: One deterministic sentence describing the decision, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.
